summary: The current codebase still contains all previously reported open findings; three of the earlier issues have been resolved (CSV injection, PDF HTML injection, and the uuid vulnerability). No critical or high‑severity new findings were discovered except for a newly identified high‑severity issue: the optional biometric app‑lock is only verified on initial launch and not on app resume, allowing an attacker to bypass the lock after the app is backgrounded. All other findings remain unchanged and un‑fixed.

findings.issue: The optional biometric/app‑lock is only evaluated once when the app first becomes ready. If the user backgrounds the app and later returns, the lock is not re‑checked, allowing any person with physical access to the device to view the unlocked UI and sensitive data without re‑authenticating.
findings.fix: Add an AppState listener (or use @react-native-community/hooks) that triggers the biometric authentication whenever the app transitions to the foreground while `appLockEnabled` is true. On failed authentication, reset the UI to a locked state (e.g., set `locked` to true and render the loading spinner or a lock screen). Ensure the lock state persists across navigation and is cleared only after successful authentication.
